# Support

Community support for the Syncfusion Blazor Toolkit is **best-effort**. This
page does not promise response, triage, fix or release deadlines, or establish a
commercial support SLA. Priorities depend on impact, reproducibility, scope and
maintainer capacity; reactions help communicate interest but do not automatically
prioritize or schedule work.

## Bug reports and feature requests

Use [GitHub issues](https://github.com/syncfusion/blazor-toolkit/issues) for
non-security bugs and feature requests. Include the toolkit package version,
.NET SDK/runtime, render mode, OS/browser, expected/actual behavior and a minimal
reproduction. Redact credentials, personal data and private URLs from logs.

The toolkit is Chart-first and does not currently include a Grid. You may propose
new components or add use cases for planned work; check the
[roadmap](../ROADMAP.md) and link related issues rather than opening duplicates.
Roadmap entries are not delivery commitments.

## Questions / discussions

Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/syncfusion/blazor-toolkit/discussions)
for usage questions and open-ended design discussion. Consult the
[toolkit documentation](https://blazor.syncfusion.com/documentation/toolkit/overview)
and [development guide](DEVELOPMENT.md) for setup. If Discussions is unavailable,
a non-sensitive question can be raised through the repository's available issue
channels; do not use public channels for security reports.

## Security disclosures

Report vulnerabilities privately to **security@syncfusion.com** and follow
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Do **not** open a public vulnerability issue or publish
exploit details; coordinate disclosure with the security team. Acknowledgment
alone is not approval for public disclosure. Response and remediation timing
must be confirmed with the security contact; no fixed deadline is established here.

## Code of conduct

Follow the [Syncfusion Code of Conduct and Corporate Ethics Policy](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
Its reporting contact is **legal@syncfusion.com**. Send conduct reports privately;
do not post personal or sensitive details in public issues.
